why_a_new_authority: the charge-state axis is part of the relation. Sprint 3's axis was the manufacturer's 2 Ah rating; this one is each pair's own measured available charge, read from cycles prior to it. A curve on a different axis is a different open-circuit voltage relation and therefore a different model, not a correction to the old one
method: pseudo-OCV by charge/discharge branch averaging within one cell, weighted by the two currents; measured relaxed anchor at the top; linear interpolation; extrapolation refused
charge_state_basis: z = 1 - q / Q_available, with Q_available established per trajectory by engcore.domains.battery.capacity from prior cycles
conditioned_on: median measured cell temperature over the loaded discharge branch. Ambient is not the conditioning variable: at 4 degC ambient the 4 A discharges self-heat to 23-41 degC and are not cold measurements
floor_rule: the lowest knot of the contiguous admitted block, where a knot is admitted only with at least 7 pairs behind it and an interquartile spread across those pairs inside the frozen acceptance tolerance

pooled.why_not_the_charge_relaxed_anchor: on a capacity-normalized axis the charge cycle's relaxed tail is not the state z = 1 names, and at low ambient the charger stops before reaching that tail at all

pooled.what_it_is: (V_charge - V_discharge) / (i_charge + i_discharge) at a common charge state: the resistance the two branches imply, measured with no model and no fit

cold.what_it_is: (V_charge - V_discharge) / (i_charge + i_discharge) at a common charge state: the resistance the two branches imply, measured with no model and no fit

warm.what_it_is: (V_charge - V_discharge) / (i_charge + i_discharge) at a common charge state: the resistance the two branches imply, measured with no model and no fit

what_it_is_not: not an equilibrium open-circuit voltage. Branch averaging does not cancel the hysteresis between the two directions and the branches are not at identical temperature within a band. The pooled curve is emitted as evidence that the bands differ, not as a curve to use; the banded curves do not interpolate between bands and refuse outside their own charge-state interval
